tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')
cur = u[u.instance_id=='i-d36dd27144c2'].iloc[0]
ct = cur.instance_type
cat = c[c.instance_type==ct].iloc[0]
req_v = cat.vcpu * cur.p95_cpu_pct/100 / 0.7
req_m = cat.memory_gib * cur.p95_mem_pct/100 / 0.8
print(ct, cat.vcpu, cat.memory_gib, req_v, req_m)
fam = c[c.family==cat.family]
cand = fam[(fam.vcpu>=req_v)&(fam.memory_gib>=req_m)].sort_values('hourly_usd')
print(cand)
